description: This is the main source file for the 'Configurator' class in a SuiteCRM module, managing system configuration, including loading, overriding, validation, and persistence of settings.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: A class responsible for managing and persisting system configuration in SuiteCRM, including loading configurations, validating input, handling override configurations, and saving changes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration by loading existing settings.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads global configuration into the class property.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates configuration settings from HTTP POST data.

methods.name: checkLoggerFileName
methods.description: Validates and constructs the logger filename and extension.

methods.name: trimValue
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: prependDot
methods.description: Ensures a file extension string starts with a dot.

methods.name: hasValidExtension
methods.description: Checks if a filename's extension is valid against a list of bad extensions.

methods.name: handleOverride
methods.description: Creates an override array based on current configuration and existing config, and writes it to a file.

methods.name: addKeyToIgnoreOverride
methods.description: Adds a key to a list of override keys to ignore during override handling.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cache if specific configuration options change, such as error trace settings.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current configuration, including images and overrides.

methods.name: readOverride
methods.description: Reads current override configuration from the 'config_override.php' file.

methods.name: saveOverride
methods.description: Writes the override configuration to 'config_override.php'.

methods.name: overrideClearDuplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate override entries for a specific array and key from the override string.

methods.name: replaceOverride
methods.description: Replaces or adds an override value for a specific array key in the override string.

methods.name: restoreConfig
methods.description: Restores configuration to defaults by re-reading override and redirecting.

methods.name: saveImages
methods.description: Saves uploaded images like the company logo.

methods.name: checkTempImage
methods.description: Validates an uploaded image for correct type before saving.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the current error message, if any.

methods.name: saveCompanyLogo
methods.description: Saves the company logo image to the custom theme directory.

methods.name: parseLoggerSettings
methods.description: Reads logger settings from a properties file and updates the configuration accordingly.

methods.name: isConfirmOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks if confirm opt-in is enabled based on email settings.

methods.name: isOptInEnabled
methods.description: Checks if opt-in is enabled based on email settings.

methods.name: getConfirmOptInTemplateId
methods.description: Retrieves the template ID used for confirm opt-in emails.

methods.name: getConfirmOptInEnumValue
methods.description: Returns the enum value representing the confirm opt-in setting.
